job.title: Respite Caregiver
job.description:
One 20-minute in-person interview at our office, then your paperwork, welcome call and 6 hours of paid training all from home on your phone or computer.

A very sweet family in Mount Vernon is looking for a caregiver to spend 8 hours a week with their loved one, a warm and lovely woman, so they can get a well-earned break.

Your time together would be simple and meaningful: good company and conversation, making lunch, and keeping the house tidy. There is no personal care in this role.

The schedule is 8 hours a week: either one 8-hour day on Mondays, or 4 hours on Mondays and 4 hours on Wednesdays. We will settle it with you and the family.

This is W-2 employment with Caring Companions, not contract work. You are paid weekly, and you complete 6 hours of paid orientation and dementia training from home before you start. If you are patient, kind and reliable, and you would enjoy being the bright spot in someone's week, we would love to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Provide friendly companionship and conversation
  • Prepare lunch and help with the meal
  • Do light housekeeping: dishes, tidying, and laundry as needed
  • Notice and report any change in how she is doing
  • Clock in and out on AxisCare and finish your notes before the end of each visit
  • Protect the family's privacy, property and confidentiality

Qualifications

  • Be at least 18 years old
  • Pass all required background screenings
  • Have reliable transportation to Mount Vernon and a working phone
  • Complete orientation, onboarding, dementia and Alzheimer's training, and annual in-service training
  • Be patient, kind and dependable
  • Be comfortable working in a client's home

Benefits

  • W-2 employment, not a contractor arrangement
  • Paid weekly
  • Paid orientation and dementia training
  • A steady, predictable schedule

job.title: Caregiver, Weekdays
job.description:
One 20-minute in-person interview at our office, then your paperwork, welcome call and 6 hours of paid training all from home on your phone or computer.

Caring Companions is looking for a dependable caregiver for a steady weekday schedule in Springfield: Monday through Friday, 7am to 5:30pm.

You can take the whole week, or share it with a second caregiver (for example Monday to Wednesday, or Thursday and Friday). Tell us what you can work and we will build the schedule around it.

You would be helping an older adult stay safe, comfortable and independent at home, working from their care plan: personal care, meals, light housekeeping, and company and conversation through the day.

This is W-2 employment, not contract work. You are paid weekly, overtime is paid over 40 hours, and you complete 6 hours of paid orientation and dementia training from home before you start. Experience helps, but reliability and kindness matter more.

Responsibilities

  • Follow the care plan and complete the care tasks assigned to you
  • Provide personal care such as bathing, dressing, grooming, oral hygiene, toileting and incontinence care, and help with feeding when appropriate
  • Help with mobility, transfers, walking and fall prevention, using proper body mechanics
  • Give medication reminders (not medication administration)
  • Prepare meals and keep the home clean and safe, including light housekeeping and laundry
  • Offer companionship and conversation, and encourage social and physical activity
  • Notice and promptly report any change in the client's condition, mental state, safety or surroundings
  • Clock in and out on AxisCare and finish your notes before the end of each shift
  • Maintain professional boundaries and protect the client's privacy, property and confidentiality

Qualifications

  • Be at least 18 years old
  • Pass all required background screenings
  • Have reliable transportation and a working phone
  • Complete orientation, onboarding, dementia and Alzheimer's training, and annual in-service training
  • Be able to stand, walk, bend and assist with transfers, and to safely support a client's mobility and lift up to 50 pounds where authorized, using proper technique and equipment such as gait belts
  • Be comfortable working in clients' homes, which may include pets and a variety of household environments

Benefits

  • W-2 employment, not a contractor arrangement
  • Paid weekly
  • Overtime paid for hours over 40 in a workweek
  • Paid orientation and Alzheimer's and dementia training (6 hours)

job.title: PRN CNA
job.description:
One 20-minute in-person interview at our office, then your paperwork, welcome call and 6 hours of paid training all from home on your phone or computer.

Start PRN. Stay flexible.

Join Caring Companions' elite PRN CNA Team and earn $20 an hour, with the flexibility to decide when you can help.

You tell us when you're generally available. When we have an opportunity that may fit, we'll text you. Can help? Accept it. Can't help? Decline it. No pressure to accept, and no guilt for declining. There may be times when you can help often and times when you can't help at all. That's the beauty of PRN. But once you accept and are confirmed, we must be able to depend on you.

PRN opportunities may include covering open shifts, being a second set of hands, supporting caregivers in the field and, when specifically approved, helping train caregivers.

Apply in about 2 minutes. We keep this team open all year.

Note: if you'd like to switch to taking an ongoing client, our CNAs are paid $18 an hour.

Qualifications

  • A current CNA certification
  • A driver's license and reliable transportation
  • At least a year of caregiving experience
  • Able to pass a background check and references

job.title: Caregiver
job.description:
One 20-minute in-person interview at our office, then your paperwork, welcome call and 6 hours of paid training all from home on your phone or computer.

Caring Companions is looking for caregivers across the Springfield area.

You would be helping older adults stay safe, independent and comfortable in their own homes. Every client has their own care plan, and you would work from it: personal care, help around the house, company and conversation, and rides to appointments when the plan calls for it.

This is W-2 employment, not contract work. You are paid weekly, overtime is paid for anything over 40 hours in a week, and you complete 6 hours of paid orientation and dementia training from home before you start. Schedules are flexible, and we will do our best to build one around what you can actually work.

Experience helps, but reliability and kindness matter more. If you have cared for someone before, even a family member, we would like to hear from you.

Responsibilities

  • Follow each client's care plan and complete the care tasks assigned to you
  • Provide personal care such as bathing, dressing, grooming, oral hygiene, toileting and incontinence care, and help with feeding when appropriate
  • Help with mobility, transfers, walking and fall prevention, using proper body mechanics
  • Give medication reminders (not medication administration)
  • Prepare meals and keep the home clean and safe, including light housekeeping and laundry
  • Offer companionship and conversation, and encourage social and physical activity
  • Drive or accompany clients to appointments and approved errands when the care plan authorizes it
  • Notice and promptly report any change in a client's condition, mental state, safety or surroundings
  • Clock in and out on AxisCare and finish your notes before the end of each shift
  • Maintain professional boundaries and protect every client's privacy, property and confidentiality

Qualifications

  • Be at least 18 years old
  • Pass all required background screenings
  • Hold a valid driver's license and current auto insurance if you will be transporting clients
  • Have reliable transportation and a working phone
  • Meet the licensing, certification and training requirements that apply to the role
  • Complete orientation, onboarding, dementia and Alzheimer's training, and annual in-service training
  • Be able to stand, walk, bend and assist with transfers, and to safely support a client's mobility and lift up to 50 pounds where authorized, using proper technique and equipment such as gait belts
  • Be comfortable working in clients' homes, which may include pets and a variety of household environments

Benefits

  • W-2 employment, not a contractor arrangement
  • Paid weekly
  • Overtime paid for hours over 40 in a workweek
  • Paid orientation and dementia training
  • Flexible scheduling built around your availability
  • Paid orientation and Alzheimer's and dementia training (6 hours)
